data.reason: Frozen v1 E1–E6 first-pass assessment. Original Taylor & Francis publisher abstract describes pilots and non-pilots rating and comparing perceived urgency of five existing helicopter auditory alarms; pilots also ranked triggering-situation urgency. Human listeners, manipulated/contrasted alarm sound properties, perceived-urgency outcomes, experimental report methods and results in abstract, and publication before 2026-10-04 support inclusion to full-text screening only. Actual sound files, allocation, exact participant N, alarm levels, full Methods, numerical result extraction and independent sample identity were not reviewed. A single publication with multiple discovery paths is not multiple independent studies.
data.access_limitation: Original publisher https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1080/0014013042000193282; DOI 10.1080/0014013042000193282; Ergonomics 47(8), 821–840 (2004), publisher page online-posting date 2007-02-20 is not the original issue year; PubMed PMID 15204277 corroborates 2004-06-22 issue. Accessed 2026-11-10: entire publisher Abstract only; full article restricted, not read. Tool-mediated public HTML text; original publisher HTTP Date, PDF bytes/hash, audio and complete Methods not obtained; rights not inferred.
